# Module 4 — conditions

Allowed: modules 1–3, plus `if`, `else`, `else if`, and `switch`.

Do not suggest or require: loops, arrays, `enum`, inheritance, interfaces, abstract classes, nested classes, collections, regular expressions, exceptions, `try`, `catch`, `throw`, lambda expressions, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, threads, files, or web APIs.

Do not ask to validate input unless the task asks for it. Review only whether the branching matches the task.
